chunks: So which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the refrain 'Fabi-ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as a dual address to humans and jinn, highlighting the cosmic scale of divine favors (ni'mah) that permeate both the physical and spiritual realms. The rhetorical question underscores the inevitability of accountability, serving as a poignant reminder that recognition of these blessings is the foundation of gratitude (shukr) and the precursor to ultimate judgment.
